title: Certify the fixed degree23 obstruction from actual raw log moments
body:
## Summary

```text
actual raw log moments0..24 → iid260 Bell + independent EGF → full-paid capped reference
fixed p23: coefficient0 PASS; coefficients1..23 FAIL
```

Adds a source-bound negative certificate for the unchanged `native-concentrated-balanced` witness. Actual moments strictly sharpen every positive Bernoulli-chord bound, but the top ratio is above `0.021677806467759466977142523404`, while complement capacity is below `0.019675906372710418424472814350`. The top coefficient depends only on the first moment and still fails with optimistic zero paid excess, so higher raw moments alone cannot repair this fixed certificate. Actual capped-law improvements and other certificates remain open; no new N or κ is asserted.

## Evidence

- **Before:** The predecessor uses a Bernoulli chord and explicitly hands off actual raw logarithmic moments; its fixed p23 chord certificate fails.
  **After:** Complete directed actual raw moments, independent Bell/EGF iid enclosures and all24 exact p23 coefficient intervals locate the strict obstruction. Existing p24 chord remains a passing positive control.
- Registered normal/`-O`, source/committed-byte ancestry checks, export integrity and Git-free read-only replay pass. Export replay takes 0.32s/0.38s. Controls cover paid normalization, iid averaging, inward rounding, full paid excess and the highest-coefficient identity.
- Source tax/log/base-range guards remain checked. Final-rank and outer-consumer checks are not reached because p23 fails; original native/outer producer proofs and physical/tape/precision contracts remain inherited. Credits preserve zxv, Sussman, PR4411/4414/4416/4433, Cinna Davis and all retained lineage; substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed.
